tasks.prompt: Fix parse_quantity in quantity.py. Return a float for finite, nonnegative integers, floats, and numeric strings (surrounding whitespace is allowed). Reject booleans, negative values, NaN, infinity, unsupported input types, and invalid strings with ValueError. Preserve valid zero and fractional values. Work only in the current task directory.

Fix unique_in_order in ordered.py. Accept an iterable of hashable values and return a list with duplicates removed in first-occurrence order. Preserve Unicode strings and support generators, empty inputs, and mixed hashable types without sorting them. Work only in the current task directory.

Fix the inventory SKU contract across sku.py and inventory.py. normalize_sku must strip surrounding whitespace and case-fold a string, raising ValueError for blank strings and non-strings. Inventory.put and Inventory.get must both use the shared normalizer. Equivalent SKUs must share a single entry, later puts replace earlier quantities, missing valid SKUs return zero, and invalid SKUs must raise ValueError without changing inventory. Preserve the existing public methods. Work only in the current task directory.
